shortDescription: This Frigidaire Professional four-door French door refrigerator offers the Custom-Flex® Temp Drawer so you can get extra space for all your most used items, from wine to frozen pizza. It helps keep produce crisp and flavorful for longer with CrispSeal® Fresh crispers featuring 3 advanced technologies. Plus, it's easy to organize and clean with our clever organization system and Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel.

features.text: Custom-Flex® Temp Drawer
Get extra space for all your creations. Store appetizers, wine, or even ice cream with the middle drawer that can be a refrigerator or a freezer.
Impressive Storage Capacity
An impressive interior storage capacity that can easily fit up to 35 bags of groceries.
CrispSeal® Fresh Crispers
Keep produce crisp and flavorful for longer with our 3 advanced technologies that work together to optimize the environment of your crisper.
SpaceWise® Organization System
Store more with clever organization solutions that maximize usable space, including a flip-up shelf, a slide-under shelf, and SnackZones.
Exterior Ice & Water Dispenser with PurePour™ Filter
Keep safer, great-tasting water flowing and reduce up to 99% of contaminants while cutting back on plastic and the cost of bottled water with our water filter.
Large Adjustable Door Bin Storage
Our adjustable gallon-size bins are designed to store more, so you can fit a variety of items like condiments and milk.
Reach more with OpenAccess™ Door
Easily access more of your favorites - reach up to 75% of your food with only one door open and get extra long bins that can store more than ever before.
TwinTech™ Cooling System
Our cooling system ensures temperature and airflow distribution is even in both the refrigerator and freezer.
Wi-Fi Connected with the Frigidaire App
Remotely control and monitor from anywhere with the Frigidaire app.
Dual Ice Maker with 12.5lbs of Ice
Always have ice on hand with the largest ice bucket capacity among 4-door French Door refrigerators with a fully convertible temperature drawer.
Tall Ice and Water Pocket
Easily fill pitchers and tall sports bottles with our water and ice dispenser, designed to accommodate containers up to 10.5 inches tall.
Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel
Resists fingerprints and cleans easily.
Flexible Storage with Reversible Bin
Use our crisper to keep your produce fresh for longer, or flip it around to use as an open compartment to easily access items such has beverages, yogurts or snacks.
ENERGY STAR® Certified
Save money and maximize energy efficiency.
Bright LED Lighting
Get a clear, bright view of your interior offering you better visibility to reach your favorites with our enhanced LED lighting.
PureAir Ultra II® Air Filter
Our air filter performs better than baking soda, capturing undesirable smells to keep your fridge fresh for longer.
Soft-Close Doors
Prevent slamming and ensure a secure seal every time with soft-close doors.
Auto-Close Doors
Ensures your doors are never left slightly open by automatically closing once the door is ajar 5” or less.
